infinity_stones.name: POWER STONE
infinity_stones.effect_text: Deal 1 damage to each Hero in the game.

infinity_stones.name: SPACE STONE
infinity_stones.effect_text: From now on, Heroes must ignore 1 ➡ each turn.

infinity_stones.name: REALITY STONE
infinity_stones.effect_text: Put all already completed Mission cards back into play.

infinity_stones.name: SOUL STONE
infinity_stones.effect_text: Thanos gains 6 Health (may go above the starting value).

infinity_stones.name: TIME STONE
infinity_stones.effect_text: Play 2 other Master Plan cards in sequence.

infinity_stones.name: MIND STONE
infinity_stones.effect_text: From now on, Heroes must play their Hero card randomly on their turn.
